question.text: Which regulator exercises direct oversight of the Social Stock Exchanges (SSEs) in India?

answer.text: Reserve Bank of India (RBI), under the RBI Act 1934
Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), under the Companies Act 2013
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), under the SEBI Act 1992 and ICDR Regulations 2018
Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), under FCRA 2010

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.38 confirms that SSEs fall under SEBI's regulatory ambit, and p.75 confirms that SSEs follow rules and regulations framed by SEBI. SEBI is therefore the regulator exercising direct oversight of the SSEs. The Trap: RBI (A) regulates banking and monetary policy, not SSEs. MCA (B) regulates Section 8 Companies for incorporation but not SSE trading. MHA (D) administers FCRA, not securities listing. Note: The SEBI regulatory-ambit framing on pp.38 and 75 is the source-backed basis for the answer.
